savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14044 in full (secs. 1-2): its only operative act is the sec. 1 amendment of EO 14007 sec. 2(b) (PCAST of not more than 32 members). EO 14148 sec. 2(r) revokes EO 14007 and sec. 2(ll) revokes EO 14044 on the same day, so the amended order and the amending order end together and nothing of the amendment remains; EO 14177 sec. 2(b) later creates a new PCAST of not more than 24 members under its own authority and does not continue the 14044 text. EO 14044 transferred no function, fund or property, set no continuing duty and created no right (sec. 2(c)). S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) KEPT after reading both. Bounded search: every held official FR text (jobs/fr-originals, EO 1 through EO 14435) was grepped for the order's number and read where it appeared; OFR catalog edges (jobs/later-events EDGES.csv), the dossier's current-law leads (none) and the three machine searches were read.

research_rationale: EO 14044 (signed 2021-09-13, 86 FR 51579), read in full from the held official FR text, only amends the first sentence of EO 14007 sec. 2(b) to read 'not more than 32 members' and has general provisions. It has no term or sunset. EO 14148 sec. 2(ll) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes EO 14044 and sec. 2(r) revokes EO 14007, both effective on signing 2025-01-20 with no effective-date wording. Dossier lead ACT:EO:14044>EO:14177 was read: EO 14177 (90 FR 8643, read in full) sec. 6 revokes EO 14007 'as amended by Executive Order 14109' on signing 2025-01-23, after EO 14148 had ended EO 14044, so it is attached as a later event after the first end and does not alter it. EO 14109 (88 FR 68447, read in full) continues the parent PCAST 'Executive Order 14007, as amended' until 2025-09-30 under FACA; it does not amend or name EO 14044 and its continuance of the parent could not outlast the 2025-01-20 revocation of the parent, so it is ruled out as an earlier-end or change event. The inventory is the dossier's six clauses; they cover secs. 1 and 2 to the signature line with no gaps. No other held official text names EO 14044 (EO 9502 contains the number as a page reference only). Savings: none found.
